title: Last To Leave A Sleeping Dragon Wins $1,000,000
description: Ten people climbed onto a sleeping dragon, and the winner did the one thing nobody tried. Could you keep your heart calm on a dragon? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Granny Wren: 80-year-old witch, long white braid, wrinkled kind face, dark green hooded cloak worn with the hood down, gnarled wooden staff, no pointed hat
characters.Mara: 30-year-old woman, black hair in a tight bun, calm narrow eyes, plain gray long-sleeve tunic, black leggings, brown boots, no hat
characters.Pip: 12-year-old boy, messy orange hair, freckles, oversized brown knitted sweater with patched elbows, tan shorts, scuffed boots, no hat

scenes.say: Ten people climb onto a sleeping dragon. The last one still on its back at sunrise wins its chest of gold, worth one million dollars.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Misty mossy hillside at dusk, one enormous red dragon asleep curled on the moss, its sides rising slowly. [4-7s] Medium shot on the moss below the dragon: Granny Wren rests one hand on a small wooden chest of gold coins. [7-10s] On the dragon's back between its spines, Pip and Mara sit in the foreground holding on, a few small figures sitting further along its spine.

scenes.say: Granny Wren, the old witch who runs it, gives one rule. Sleeping dragons feel heartbeats. If your heart races, it shrugs you off like a fly, into the soft moss below.
scenes.video: [0-4s] On the mossy hillside, Granny Wren raises her wooden staff and speaks calmly, the sleeping dragon behind her. [4-7s] Close-up of the dragon's scaly side; a faint red glow pulses under the scales like a heartbeat. [7-10s] On the dragon's back, Pip swallows nervously and Mara closes her eyes and breathes slowly.

scenes.say: So at the very first snore, a hot cloud of smoke rolls over its back. Four people scream, and four people slide gently off into the moss. Six left.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Close-up of the dragon's sleeping face on the mossy hillside, a slow puff of gray smoke curling out of its nostrils. [4-7s] On the dragon's back, smoke drifts past Pip, who coughs and holds on tight. [7-10s] Wide shot of the mossy hillside at night: small figures slide down the dragon's side and land softly in the deep moss.

scenes.say: At midnight it rolls onto its side in a dream. Four more panic and drop. Now it's just Mara, who meditates every morning, against Pip, a twelve-year-old who can't stop yawning.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Under a starry sky on the mossy hillside, the huge red dragon rolls slowly onto its side. [4-7s] Medium shot on the dragon's tilted back: Mara sits perfectly still, eyes closed, hands resting on her knees. [7-10s] Close-up of Pip clinging to a spine, letting out a huge yawn.

scenes.say: Mara counts her breaths for six straight hours, calm as stone. Pip gives up, curls against the warm scales, and starts snoring. At dawn, one huge golden eye opens.
scenes.video: [0-4s] On the dragon's back under fading stars, Mara sits upright, lips moving slightly as she counts. [4-7s] Pip curls up asleep against the dragon's warm red scales, mouth open, snoring. [7-10s] Extreme close-up at sunrise on the mossy hillside: the dragon's huge golden eye slowly opens.

scenes.say: At sunrise, Mara realizes she's won. Her heart jumps, and the dragon shrugs her off. Pip snores straight through it. Ten people climbed a sleeping dragon. Only the sleeper won.
scenes.video: [0-4s] On the dragon's back at sunrise, Mara's eyes snap open and she starts to smile. [4-7s] The dragon rolls one shoulder and Mara slides down its side into the soft moss, stunned. [7-10s] Golden morning light on the mossy hillside: Pip still asleep on the dragon's back as Granny Wren chuckles and sets the chest of gold beside the dragon's claw.
